models.notes: Served on Cerebras wafer-scale silicon. Dual-bucket model: uncached TPM (primary limit) and total TPM (3x uncached). Free trial requires adding a payment method to receive $5 credit; expires in 30 days.

free.notes: Free trial. Also 1M tokens/hour (TPH) hard cap.

developer.notes: Pay as You Go (first credit purchase). No hourly or daily token caps.
